verdict.rationale: Bitbucket docs explicitly claim IP allowlisting as a security feature, directly matching the story's core ask, but this is only a brief vendor mention with no detail on granularity (per-workspace/repo scoping, CIDR ranges) or independent corroboration; community evidence even notes gaps in admin control over repo visibility, though not specifically about IP restrictions. missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring IP ranges/CIDR scope, per-repo vs per-workspace granularity, independent/hands-on confirmation.
